verdict.rationale: Riveter documents a broad public API (an OpenAPI spec, a Go SDK and an MCP server) covering its core primitives: enrichments, dataset building, scrapes, quick_search, search_agent, run listing and results, webhooks, dry-run credit estimates and credit caps. However, nothing states that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature. UI-advertised features such as scheduling projects to monitor for changes, including minute-level refresh, have no documented API endpoint. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API endpoints for scheduling/monitoring projects, and independent or hands-on confirmation of parity.
